title: Stable and Fair Random Allocations in a Two-Sided Discrete-Concave Market
abstract: arXiv:2606.18574v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study random allocations in two-sided many-to-many matching markets with ties, where random tie-breaking can violate ex ante stability and fairness. We show that, when valuations are discrete concave (M$^\natural$-concave), stable and fair fractional allocations always exist and form a distributive lattice under the induced preference orders. Every such allocation can be implemented as a lottery over stable deterministic allocations that simultaneously gives every agent the highest expected utility compatible with her fractional bundle. Since cardinal utilities are difficult to elicit, we then ask what ordinal preferences over deterministic outcomes can identify. The set of stable and fair fractional allocations is the same for all M$^\natural$-concave valuations consistent with the same ordinal preferences, although utility-preserving lotteries may differ across them. No such dependence arises for additive valuations under matroi

translated_title: 双边离散凹市场中的稳定且公平的随机分配
translated_abstract: 我们研究了存在平局的双边多对多匹配市场中的随机分配问题，在此类市场中，随机打破平局可能违反事前稳定性与公平性。我们证明，当估值满足离散凹性（M♮-凹性）时，稳定且公平的分数分配总是存在，并且在由此导出的偏好序下构成一个分配格。每一个这样的分配都可以实现为一个由稳定确定性分配构成的彩票，该彩票同时为每个代理人提供与其分数束相容的最高期望效用。由于基数效用难以引出，我们进而探讨基于确定性结果的序数偏好能够识别什么。我们证明，对于与相同序数偏好一致的所有M♮-凹估值，稳定且公平的分数分配集合是相同的，尽管保持效用的彩票可能因估值不同而有所差异。而对于拟阵结构下的加性估值，则不存在这种依赖关系。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明在双边多对多匹配市场中，当估值满足M♮-凹性时，稳定且公平的分数分配必然存在、构成分配格、可通过稳定确定性分配上的彩票实现，且该分配集合仅由序数偏好即可识别，与具体基数估值无关。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in two-sided many-to-many matching markets with ties, when valuations are M♮-concave, stable and fair fractional allocations always exist, form a distributive lattice, can be implemented as lotteries over stable deterministic allocations, and are uniquely identified by ordinal preferences alone, independent of the underlying cardinal valuations.
